thread:
Mason: Quick heads-up — after enabling the FlashAttention v3 kernel heuristics on the canary pool we’re seeing ~12% p95 latency regression for short sequences (<64) on GA4 nodes. Anyone else seeing this?
Anya: yep, saw the same on dedicated-canary. traces show more fallbacks to the generic matmul path for 1-4 token prefixes.
perf-bot: Canary metrics: fa-v3 ON on canary-3 -> p95 +11.8% (seq<64), throughput -3%, error-rate stable. Sampled request ids attached.
Deepak: Hypothesis: v3 tiling/stripe workspace allocation increases fragmentation for small batches and forces extra memcpy/copy paths, adding ms per request. Need alloc/free flamegraphs.
Sarah: Also noticed KV-cache warm start takes ~2-3ms longer in the sampled traces. Might be additional memops in the v3 adapter. Sharing a short pprof link: https://g.w.example/pprof/2145006812 (internal)
Mason: Can we get a kernel-selection trace in runtime for the affected requests? I'd like: model, seq_len, batch_sz, selected_kernel, workspace_needed, fallback_reason. Add as a sampled trace first.
Anya: Agreed. Quick telemetry config we can enable for 1% sampling: 
```
runtime.telemetry.flashattn.selection_trace = true
runtime.telemetry.flashattn.sample_rate = 0.01
runtime.telemetry.kernel_debug = "selection,workspace"
```
Deepak: Also check quantization/precision path — v3 may pick fp16 kernels where v2 took bf16 on these nodes. On A100 bf16 had better perf for tiny seqs in our microbench.
Sarah: Good call. I saw a couple kernel logs with "chosen: f64_to_fp16_cast" which looks like an extra conversion step.
Mason: Short-term plan: revert canary to fa-v2 to stop user impact, and run an isolated microbench matrix: seq in [8,16,32,64,128,256], batch 1..8, device types GA4/GA3, quant flags. If revert restores baseline we know config heuristics caused it.
Deepak: I'll prep the microbench harness and add extra traces for alloc size histogram + memcpy counts.
Anya: Also propose adding a tiny change to heuristics: prefer v2-v3 crossover point at seq>=96 for small batch sizes until we investigate further.
Mason: OK I'll revert now and kick off microbench. tagging @Anya to follow telemetry.
ops-bot: Revert job queued for canary-3 (job id r-2145007198).
ops-bot: Revert completed on canary-3 at 2145007230 :white_check_mark:
Mason: After revert p95 returned to baseline within 30m on canary-3.
Anya: Microbench started. Early results: v3 wins on seq>=128 consistently but regresses for seq<=64 at batch<=4. Attaching small matrix summary in channel.
Deepak: Next steps: (1) add defragmentation hook to workspace allocator, (2) make kernel crossover configurable per-device and per-batch-size, (3) emit selection telemetry to correlate with memcpy counts.
Sarah: Also plan a canary with v3 + allocator-defrag patch and instrumentation before full rollout.
Mason: Sounds good. Can someone draft a short RFC follow-up with the proposed heuristics, telemetry columns, and rollout checklist? Keep it focused so we can iterate quickly.
Anya: I'll write it up tonight and post to #eng-runtime RFCs. :thumbsup:
Mason: Thanks — keeping this thread to coordinate. If anyone sees odd error spikes after revert ping here.
